extraction.summary: Jordan Belfort of Harbourline IT cold-called Donnie Azoff, CFO of Marlowe & Finch Accounting, a 34-person practice in Hawthorn facing a cyber insurance renewal. Jordan proposed 30 seats of managed IT at $135 per seat per month ($48,600 annually) with onboarding at cost, claiming Essential Eight compliance within a week. Donnie pushed back on price, the unsupported claim that the insurer would halve premiums, the unverified assertion that the incumbent is losing certification, seat coverage for casual staff, and pressure tactics; he also noted the incumbent is trusted. Donnie agreed only to review a proposal sent by 5pm on 11 September with the managing partner, and would sign a 30-seat agreement and start Monday if terms match.
